result.summary: The page is mostly well structured, but a prominent restaurant card has a failed/missing image and lower content is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The image area for the “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” card displays a generic broken-image placeholder instead of restaurant imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading state and provide a branded fallback image if the restaurant image is unavailable.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next restaurant card image at the bottom of the screen, hiding part of the content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
